summary: Tome is a self-hosted ebook and manga library server that includes a built-in web reader, OPDS support, and automated metadata fetching. It features a dedicated KOReader plugin to synchronise reading positions bi-directionally and track reading sessions for statistics such as streaks and heatmaps.
goodFor: It suits self-hosters who want to organise digital book collections and use KOReader for synchronised reading across devices.
watchOut: The project lacks tagged releases and has no recorded commit history in recent months, suggesting it may be early-stage, unmaintained, or experimental.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to map persistent volumes for your media library and configuration data, alongside a reverse proxy for handling TLS.
